core_en: Put your insights into six parts. Together they form a world that pulls your attention toward what moves the needle — like a game pulls a player in.
core_zh: 把洞察整理成六个部分。它们合起来会形成一个世界，像游戏吸引玩家一样，把你的注意力拉向真正重要的事。

diagram.caption_en: Six parts form concentric circles that guard your attention — vision is how you win, anti-vision is what is at stake, the one-year goal is the mission, the one-month project is the boss fight, daily actions are the quests, and constraints are the rules.
diagram.caption_zh: 六个部分像同心圆一样保护你的注意力 —— 愿景是“赢”，反愿景是“代价”，一年目标是主线任务，一个月项目是 Boss 战，每日行动是支线任务，底线是规则。

game_parts.en: What is the ideal life I want, which I can improve as I work toward it?
game_parts.zh: 我想过上的理想生活，并且可以在追求中不断完善。

game_parts.en: What is the life I never want to experience again?
game_parts.label_zh: 反愿景 = 输了会怎样
game_parts.zh: 我再也不想经历的生活。

game_parts.en: What will my life look like in 1 year, and is that closer to the life I want?
game_parts.label_zh: 一年目标 = 主线任务
game_parts.zh: 一年后我的生活会是什么样？离想要的生活更近了吗？

game_parts.en: What do I need to learn and build to move closer to the one-year goal?
game_parts.label_zh: 一个月项目 = Boss 战
game_parts.zh: 我需要学什么、做出什么，才能靠近一年目标？

game_parts.en: What are the priority tasks that move the project forward each day?
game_parts.label_zh: 每日行动 = 支线任务
game_parts.zh: 每天哪些优先任务能推动项目前进？

game_parts.en: What am I not willing to sacrifice to achieve my vision?
game_parts.zh: 为了实现愿景，我绝不愿意牺牲什么？

label: Chapter 07 · 把人生变成游戏

paragraphs.en: Games are fun because they have a clear win, real stakes, a mission, a boss to beat, daily quests, and rules that force creativity. Your life can have the same structure — if you write it down and live inside it every day.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏好玩，是因为有明确的赢法、真实的代价、主线任务、要打的 Boss、每日任务和逼你动脑的规则。你的人生也可以有同样的结构 —— 只要你把它写下来，并且每天活在里面。

paragraphs.en: The more you play, the stronger the pull becomes. One day, it is no longer a system you follow. It is simply who you are.
paragraphs.zh: 玩得越多，这股拉力就越强。有一天，它不再是你“遵守的系统”，它就是你本人。

title_en: Turn your life into a video game
title_zh: 把人生变成一场你想玩的游戏

vocab.def_zh: 赌注；利害关系。What’s at stake? = 冒着失去什么的风险？
vocab.example_zh: 你的未来正处在关键时刻。

vocab.def_zh: 任务；探索（游戏里常说的支线/主线任务）。
vocab.example_zh: 今天的任务：写 200 个词。

vocab.def_zh: 同心的；有共同圆心的（像一圈圈涟漪）。
vocab.example_zh: 同心圆守护着你的注意力。

vocab.def_zh: 综合；把零散的洞察整合成一个整体。
vocab.example_en: Synthesise today’s insights into one plan.
vocab.example_zh: 把今天的洞察整合成一个计划。
